cases.name: Ed25519 verification
cases.comment: Compute-heavy benchmark using a pure-Solidity Ed25519 verifier. Each measured transaction verifies the first valid vector from Rainbow's official ed25519-tests.json, including software SHA-512, field exponentiation, point decompression, and elliptic-curve arithmetic without a hash or signature-verification host function.

inputs.comment: Allocate the account used to deploy and preflight the verifier.
Deploy the Solidity 0.8 port of a Ed25519 verifier.
Measured loop: each fresh sender submits one independent Ed25519 verification.

steps.comment: Use an independent nonce chain so benchmark transactions can be submitted concurrently.
